title: Run a study from chat with validated parameters
description: This verifies that a user can request a study in chat, receive execution guidance, and complete the study with a returned result.

steps.description: Navigate to the chat workspace
Enter a request to run a study
Send the message
Verify clarification or execution guidance is displayed
Submit the validated study parameters
Verify a computation result is returned

title: Run a load flow study and review the results
description: This verifies that a user can submit a valid load flow study and open the returned result to review the computed system metrics.

steps.description: Navigate to the study workspace
Submit a valid load flow study request
Open the returned study result
Verify bus voltages, angles, flows, and losses are displayed
Verify the study result is available for review

title: Run a short circuit study and review the fault results
description: This verifies that a user can submit a valid short circuit study and inspect the returned fault current results.

steps.description: Navigate to the study workspace
Submit a valid short circuit study request
Open the returned study result
Verify fault current results are displayed
Verify the study result is available for review

title: Retrieve grounded standards guidance in chat
description: A user can ask a standards-related engineering question in chat and receive a grounded answer based on retrieved knowledge.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the chat workspace
Fill in the chat input with a standards lookup question
Send the chat message
Verify a grounded engineering answer is streamed or displayed
Verify supporting knowledge or reference context is shown

title: Ask a standards question and receive grounded guidance
description: This verifies that a user can ask an engineering standards question in chat and receive a streamed, evidence-based response.

steps.description: Navigate to the chat workspace
Enter a standards or equipment question
Send the message
Verify streamed engineering guidance is displayed
Verify the response is grounded in retrieved context

title: Refine a knowledge query with additional context
description: A user can ask a topology or relationship question in chat and then refine it with a follow-up to receive a more specific network explanation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the chat workspace
Fill in the chat input with a topology relationship question
Send the chat message
Fill in the chat input with a follow-up question about connected equipment
Send the chat message
Verify the response becomes more specific to the connected network context

title: Refuse unsupported engineering requests and recover with approved inputs
description: A user making an unsupported request receives a fail-closed refusal and can then obtain evidence-based guidance by providing approved references.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the chat workspace
Fill in the chat input with a request that requires unsupported or inaccessible content
Send the chat message
Verify a fail-closed refusal is displayed
Fill in the chat input with an approved standards or document reference
Send the chat message
Verify an evidence-based engineering answer is displayed

title: Correct an invalid study submission and run it successfully
description: This verifies that invalid study parameters are rejected, then accepted after correction, with a valid result returned.

steps.description: Navigate to the study workspace
Submit an incomplete study request
Verify a study validation error is visible
Correct the study parameters
Submit the corrected study request
Verify a study result is returned

title: Confirm backend health before viewing live telemetry
description: A user can verify backend health and then open the digital twin view to receive live telemetry updates.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the digital twin and SCADA view
Verify backend health via /healthz is healthy
Wait for live telemetry updates
Verify live telemetry data is displayed

title: Clarify an ambiguous engineering request in chat
description: This verifies that an ambiguous or unsupported engineering request is met with a constrained clarification prompt and can be resolved with follow-up input.

steps.description: Navigate to the chat workspace
Enter an ambiguous engineering request
Send the message
Verify a clarification prompt is displayed
Provide the missing inputs
Verify a constrained non-hallucinated response is displayed

title: Interpret a telemetry alarm in chat
description: A user can ask chat to interpret a current telemetry state and receive operational guidance for investigating the event.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the digital twin and SCADA view
Observe the current device or alarm state
Open the chat workspace
Fill in the chat input with a request to interpret the observed telemetry state
Send the chat message
Verify operational guidance for the telemetry state is displayed

title: Handle missing knowledge with a grounded fallback
description: A user asking for information with no relevant indexed evidence receives a constrained fallback and can improve the answer by providing more specific terms.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the chat workspace
Fill in the chat input with an intentionally vague engineering question
Send the chat message
Verify a constrained fallback response is displayed
Fill in the chat input with a more specific follow-up question
Send the chat message
Verify a more targeted knowledge response is displayed

title: Request telemetry with missing context and recover with a precise asset request
description: A user asking for unavailable telemetry receives a constrained response and can refine the request with the correct asset or time window to get useful context.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the chat workspace
Fill in the chat input with a request for unavailable telemetry data
Send the chat message
Verify a constrained missing-data response is displayed
Fill in the chat input with the correct asset or time range
Send the chat message
Verify a contextual telemetry answer is displayed

title: Open a known result after an invalid result lookup
description: This verifies that an unknown or expired result reference is handled and a valid result can still be opened afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to the study results area
Open an unknown or expired study result reference
Verify a not found state is visible
Open a valid study result reference
Verify computation results are displayed

title: Show degraded health when telemetry dependencies are unavailable
description: A user can see that the platform is unhealthy or degraded when required dependencies are not available and later return to a healthy state after recovery.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the digital twin and SCADA view
Verify backend health is degraded or unhealthy
Verify the monitoring view indicates reduced availability

title: Recover from a malformed chat submission
description: This verifies that a malformed chat payload is rejected and a valid message can then receive a streamed response.

steps.description: Navigate to the chat workspace
Send a malformed chat message
Verify a chat validation error is visible
Send a valid engineering message
Verify streamed assistant responses are displayed
